mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_assessment_judgement WHERE answer_id = #{answerId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM tb_assessment_judgement WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) * FROM tb_assessment_judgement WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND source = 'AUTO' AND status = 'JUDGED' AND result_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id, updated_at DESC, id DESC

WITH ranked_judgement AS ( SELECT j.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY j.question_id, j.user_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'algorithm' THEN j.score END DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'algorithm' AND j.result_code = 'AC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, j.updated_at DESC, j.id DESC ) AS display_rank FROM tb_assessment_judgement j JOIN tb_assessment_question q ON q.id = j.question_id WHERE j.question_id = #{questionId} AND j.status = 'JUDGED' ), display_judgement AS ( SELECT * FROM ranked_judgement WHERE display_rank = 1 ) SELECT a.id AS answer_id, q.id AS question_id, q.assessment_time_id, q.question_no, q.title AS question_title, q.question_type, q.score AS max_score, u.id AS candidate_user_id, u.student_id, u.username, u.nickname, a.file_id, a.content, a.language, a.submit_time, dj.id AS judgement_id, dj.score AS judgement_score, dj.max_score AS judgement_max_score, dj.status AS judgement_status, dj.result_code, dj.source, dj.reviewer_id, dj.reviewer_type, dj.comment AS judgement_comment, dj.judged_at, t.id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, CASE WHEN t.leader_id = u.id THEN true ELSE false END AS is_leader FROM tb_assessment_answer a JOIN tb_assessment_question q ON q.id = a.question_id JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_assessment_team_member tm ON tm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN tb_assessment_team t ON t.id = tm.team_id AND t.assessment_time_id = q.assessment_time_id LEFT JOIN display_judgement dj ON dj.question_id = q.id AND dj.user_id = u.id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId}
AND (u.username ILIKE ('%' || CAST(#{keyword} AS TEXT) || '%') OR u.nickname ILIKE ('%' || CAST(#{keyword} AS TEXT) || '%') OR u.student_id ILIKE ('%' || CAST(#{keyword} AS TEXT) || '%'))
AND dj.id IS NOT NULL
AND dj.id IS NULL
ORDER BY t.id NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN t.leader_id = u.id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.student_id ASC, a.submit_time DESC, a.id DESC
